scale: Unified language-guided human seeking and persistent following benchmark requiring semantic exploration, delayed identity grounding, phase switching, and recovery in single- and multi-person environments
created_by: Kun Yu, Jianhua Yang, Yixiang Chen, Changwei Wang, Hongyuan Yu, and collaborators
release_note: The arXiv record links no benchmark package, simulator configuration, code, checkpoint, or license.
scope_note: Robot-agent human seeking and following rather than human wearable capture.

name: GigaWorld-Policy-0.5
scale: Action-centered WAM combining action-conditioned world modeling, mixed WAM training, Mixture-of-Transformers experts, and agentic AutoResearch; reports 85 ms local inference on an RTX 4090 without decoding future video at deployment
created_by: Angen Ye, Angyuan Ma, Boyuan Wang, Chaojun Ni, Fangzheng Ye, Guan Huang, and collaborators
release_note: The official repository and ungated 24.1 GB Apache-2.0 checkpoint are public. The GitHub repository itself does not currently expose a recognized license file, so the recorded license follows the model card.
scope_note: Robot world-action model rather than human wearable video.

name: Industrial Dexterity Benchmark
scale: Hardware benchmark boards for datacenter cabling, automotive harnesses, and gearbox assembly, plus DAG-ROS and multimodal AG-iDP3; the strongest cable configuration reaches 78% versus 36% for single-camera RGB with about 100 demonstrations per phase
created_by: Honglu He, Jacob Laufer, Zhiwu Zheng, David Elkan-Gonzalez, Raman Goyal, and collaborators
release_note: The arXiv record provides no public board designs, DAG-ROS or AG-iDP3 implementation, demonstrations, benchmark harness, or license.
scope_note: Industrial robot-manipulation benchmark rather than human wearable capture.

name: PhysClaw-0
scale: Autonomous collect-verify-reset system that converts operator language corrections into reusable structured memory, reducing human working time to 16% and raising average single-attempt success from 12.5% to 47.5%
created_by: Boyuan Wang, Zhenyuan Zhang, Zhiqin Yang, Peijun Gu, Shuya Wang, and collaborators
release_note: The Apache-2.0 repository packages the collection, verification, reset, and correction-memory pipeline; its README notes that proprietary AnyGrasp runtime and checkpoint assets are not redistributed.
scope_note: Robot autonomous-data-collection toolkit rather than human wearable first-person capture.

name: DenseReward
scale: Dense frame-level vision-language reward model trained with automatically synthesized physical failures such as collisions, missed grasps, drops, and recovery behaviors, evaluated for simulated and real manipulation plus MPC and RL guidance
release_note: The paper says its dataset, trained reward models, and evaluation suite are released, but the linked dense-reward.github.io project URL returned a GitHub Pages 404 and no public repository or model package was discoverable during this audit.
scope_note: Robot-camera reward learning rather than human or animal wearable first-person capture.

name: FlowWAM
scale: Dual-stream world-action model using optical flow as a shared video-native action representation; reports 92.94% RoboTwin Clean and 92.14% Random success plus a 63.71 WorldArena EWMScore
release_note: Apache-2.0 training and RoboTwin inference code, open Hugging Face checkpoints, and a downloadable RoboTwin-derived flow dataset are public; the companion WorldArena evaluation repository is also live.
scope_note: Robot-only manipulation and world modeling rather than human wearable-video capture.

name: ChunkFlow
scale: Continuity-consistent chunked-policy framework with frozen, editable, and future zones, overlap blending, seam and derivative losses, history corruption, scheduled sampling, and AWAC fine-tuning
release_note: The arXiv paper and JavaScript project route are public, but the scan found no linked code repository, checkpoint, training data, or license.
scope_note: Robot policy continuity method without a human wearable-video resource.

name: ExToken
scale: Structured VLA reinforcement fine-tuning that derives discrete behavioral priors from offline demonstrations, conditions rollout exploration on tokens, and learns a state-conditioned token selector for deterministic deployment
release_note: The arXiv record exposes no project page, implementation, checkpoints, rollout data, or license.
scope_note: Robot VLA reinforcement-learning method rather than an egocentric human-data resource.

name: Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0
scale: Approximately 30B-parameter embodied MoE VLM activating about 3B parameters per token; evaluated on 38 physical-world benchmarks and ranked first among compared similarly sized models on 19, with an 8.4% average gain over HY-Embodied-0.5
created_by: Tencent Hunyuan and Tencent Robotics X
release_note: The official repository was updated on July 15 with Apache-2.0 Transformers and vLLM inference code, and an ungated Apache-2.0 Hugging Face checkpoint is live; fine-tuning code remains unchecked on the roadmap.
scope_note: General physical-world and robot-agent VLM rather than a human wearable first-person dataset or model.

name: Jetson-PI
scale: Foresight-aligned asynchronous VLA inference for Jetson Orin, reporting 8.66x higher control frequency than naive PyTorch, 5.41x over vla.cpp, and a 14.8% average success-rate gain over VLASH on LIBERO
release_note: Apache-2.0 LIBERO training and evaluation code is public, the separate Jetson-PI-Edge runtime repository is live, and pi0.5 plus future-correction checkpoints are downloadable from ModelScope.
scope_note: Onboard robot VLA deployment stack rather than a human wearable first-person resource.

name: TrustVLA
scale: Retraining-free defense that detects abnormal VLA evidence evolution, localizes compact visual-trigger regions by counterfactual score drop, and recovers observations through localized inpainting
release_note: The arXiv record provides no project page, implementation, evaluation assets, poisoned checkpoints, or license.
scope_note: Robot VLA security method rather than a human wearable-video resource.

name: Self-in-Space / SIS-Bench
scale: 4,856 expert-verified QA pairs across 13 self-awareness and spatial-cognition tasks from 1,646 real-world UAV videos, plus 54,298 public SIS-Motion training examples and an open motion-aware adapter
release_note: The official repository records ACM MM 2026 acceptance; Apache-2.0 code, the 4,856-row SIS-Bench, 54,298-row SIS-Motion-54K training set, and SIS-Motion adapter are all public and ungated.
scope_note: Agent-centered UAV onboard video rather than human or animal wearable first-person capture.

name: VistaVLA
scale: Grounds geometry- and semantics-aware 3D Gaussian primitives into compact VLA context tokens; reports 99% token reduction, +22.8% success over seven real tasks, and +30.0% over VLA-Adapter on OOD tasks
release_note: The arXiv record provides no public project page, code, checkpoint, training data, or license.
scope_note: Robot manipulation from multi-view observations rather than human wearable first-person capture.

name: Efficient VLA Inference via Temporal Redundancy Reduction
scale: System-level VLA acceleration that updates only dynamic visual tokens and compresses diffusion action sampling to two steps, reporting more than 2x speedup and up to 98% success across LIBERO, RoboTwin, and real robots
release_note: The paper states that code will be released, but the current arXiv record links no repository, checkpoints, evaluation assets, or license.
scope_note: Robot VLA inference optimization rather than a human wearable-video resource.

name: Vinci2 / EgoServe
scale: 3,000+ proactive-service instances across 11 service categories and four temporal memory horizons, with the training-free EgoMemo agent combining multi-scale summaries, a semantic graph, and visual retrieval archives
created_by: Dalian University of Technology, Shanda AI Research Tokyo, and The University of Tokyo
release_note: ECCV acceptance is stated in the arXiv record; the MIT-licensed EgoMemo implementation and CC-BY-4.0 EgoServe annotations are public. The annotations reference source videos from EgoLife, HoloAssist, and CaptainCook4D rather than redistributing them.

name: LightMem-Ego
scale: Streaming multimodal memory system that aligns first-person visual and audio capture into current, short-term, and long-term memory for object finding, conversation recall, life summaries, routine discovery, and evidence-grounded answers
created_by: Zhejiang University NLP Group and collaborators
release_note: Public MIT-licensed repository includes the memory runtime, backend and frontend, plus an Android client for Rokid AI glasses; the arXiv record describes the work as ongoing.

name: EgoSteer
scale: Full-stack dexterous VLA system using EgoSmith to curate 9.6K hours of egocentric human video, an open robot stack for teleoperation and correction, and 3B base and RealMan checkpoints; evaluated on 40+ tasks with 75%+ few-shot success on long-horizon tasks
created_by: Yifan Zhong, Zhang Chen, Tianrui Guan, Fanlian Zeng, and Yaodong Yang
release_note: Apache-2.0 policy, EgoSmith, and robot-stack repositories are public; Hugging Face hosts open Apache-2.0 EgoSteer-3B-Base and EgoSteer-3B-RealMan checkpoints of about 5.58 GB each.

name: InterPet4D
scale: 113 human-dog interaction sessions with 6.8M synchronized multi-view and egocentric frames from 13 dogs across 11 breeds and 23 people; public v1 provides 227 headset clips with audio and aligned SMPL, MANO, pet skeleton, SMAL, and MERT features
modalities: egocentric-video; multiview-video; audio; 3d-human-motion; hand-motion; skeleton; mesh
release_note: HF API and file scan verified an ungated 10.7 GB CC-BY-NC-4.0 release with 227 rows; the current Hub package exposes synchronized derived motion/audio assets rather than the paper's complete 6.8M-frame raw multi-view capture.

name: REGRIND
scale: Retargeting-guided residual reinforcement-learning recipe that learns contact-rich dexterous policies from one human demonstration and transfers zero-shot to LEAP and WUJI hands for scissors and screwdriver tasks
created_by: Cornell University and Amazon Frontier AI & Robotics
release_note: The project page's code button targets github.com/yunhaif/regrind, which returned 404 during this audit; no model, dataset, or license was available.
scope_note: Human hand-object reference motion and robot control without a documented wearable first-person video release.

name: TeleDexter
scale: Hand-object co-tracking controller trained with single-stage RL and transferred zero-shot across two dexterous hands; reports 75.2% average success over seven in-hand and tool-use tasks and uses 50 demonstrations per task for behavior cloning
created_by: Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence and collaborators
release_note: Project page and paper are public, but no code, trained controller, demonstration data, or license was linked.
scope_note: Dexterous robot teleoperation and human reference motions, not a released human wearable-video resource.

name: WALA
scale: Learns executable latent actions jointly from action-labeled demonstrations and action-free human or robot videos using DINOv3 feature deltas, dense depth, and a trainable latent world model; reports 75.2% RoboCasa success
modalities: robot-camera-video; human-demonstrations; dense-features; depth; latent-actions; robot-actions
release_note: Official project page labels code as coming soon and exposes no checkpoints, training data, or license.
